old_row.relationship: Repeated deliverance recital of hand, arm, visions and signs
old_row.rationale: Both recount Egypt's deliverance through mighty hand, uplifted arm, great visions, signs and wonders, preserving the explicit features of the Lord's action named in each recital.

new_row.relationship: Repeated deliverance recital of hand, arm, visions and signs
new_row.rationale: Both recount deliverance from Egypt through mighty hand, uplifted arm, great visions, signs and wonders, preserving the explicit features of the Lord's action named in each recital.

old_row.relationship: Choosing the Lord and pledging to hear His voice
old_row.rationale: Both describe the people choosing the Lord and committing to obey His voice; Joshua records the people's spoken pledge and the removal of foreign gods, while Deuteronomy enumerates walking and keeping ordinances.

new_row.relationship: Choosing the Lord and pledging to hear His voice
new_row.rationale: Both describe the people choosing the Lord and committing to obey His voice; Joshua records their spoken pledge and commands removal of foreign gods, while Deuteronomy enumerates walking and keeping ordinances.
